proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 410 article gives Malayalam i, ī this; ivaṇ, ivaḷ, ivar, itu, iva this man, this woman, these persons, this thing, these things; iṅṅu in this direction, here; iṅṅanē, iṅṅinē thus; iṅṅiṭē, iṅṅiṭa here, hither; iṅṅōṭṭu hither, this way; itā behold here!; ittaram this kind, thus;…. The Malayalam survey form iŋŋə “here” is proposed within this article family. Lindgren assigns the corresponding Tamil reflex to the same source cognate set.
